user.title: Fake HVAC system
user.description: Create a simulated room, outdoor sensor, radiator switch and air conditioner. The simulation is only used for ClimateRouter tests.

abort.already_configured: A fake HVAC system with this name already exists.

set_outdoor_temperature.name: Set outdoor temperature
set_outdoor_temperature.description: Set the simulated outdoor temperature used by the fake HVAC lab.

set_room_temperature.name: Set room temperature
set_room_temperature.description: Force the simulated room temperature to a value.

set_simulation.name: Set simulation
set_simulation.description: Enable or pause the thermal simulation ticker.

set_availability.name: Set sensor availability
set_availability.description: Mark the fake room or outdoor sensor as available or unavailable.

advance.name: Advance simulation
advance.description: Fast-forward the thermal simulation by a number of simulated minutes.

reset.name: Reset simulation
reset.description: Reset the fake system to its configured starting state.
